close_reason: Rewrote jmap-metadata-server for draft-02: removed MetadataBackend trait, register_metadata_handlers, MemoryBackend, and all 5 Metadata/* handlers. Replaced with 3 pure-function modules (validate, changes, filter) providing 8 public helpers. 56 unit + 8 doc tests pass. Version bumped to 0.2.0; jmap-types and jmap-server deps removed.
description:
Complete rewrite of jmap-metadata-server to align with draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02.

**What changes:**
- DELETE: All 5 standalone method handlers (handle_metadata_get, handle_metadata_set, handle_metadata_query, handle_metadata_query_changes, handle_metadata_changes)
- DELETE: register_metadata_handlers (no Metadata/* methods exist in -02)
- DELETE: MetadataBackend trait (standalone shape)
- DELETE: MemoryBackend (standalone shape) + all unit/integration tests
- ADD: MetadataExtension trait — augments existing JmapBackend/extension backends with metadata awareness. Methods for: validating namespace identifiers, enforcing metadataMaxSize/privateMetadataMaxSize limits, handling ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges on /changes responses, populating updatedProperties on /changes responses
- ADD: Metadata-aware filter helpers — implement the 6 new filter conditions (metadataExists etc.) as composable predicates that extension-server MemoryBackends can call from their query_objects matchers
- ADD: Metadata-aware /changes helpers — implement ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges (request arg) and updatedProperties (response field) per §2.5
- The crate shifts from 'standalone extension server' to 'augmentation library' — it no longer registers its own method names; instead, consumers (mail-server, chat-server, etc.) integrate its helpers into their existing handlers

**Spec reference:** draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §2.4 (Querying), §2.5 (Changes), §3.1 (Capability)

**Architecture:** The -02 model means metadata support is opt-in per extension-server crate. This crate provides the shared helpers; each extension-server crate decides whether to integrate them. The testjig also needs updating (JMAP-ua37.5).
title: Rewrite jmap-metadata-server for -02 architecture
